annotator_notes: FIRST GENUINE MULTI-GAP ITEM in the gold set, and the item that forced the v0.22 known_gaps list schema: 'mutual_obligation' (section 8.4 -- each party owes the other, reciprocal direction unrepresentable) AND 'unless_unsupported' (section 8.2 -- '(unless an exemption is provided)' is a carve-out IR v1's grammar cannot parse at all). Both sit inside THIS span, unlike C02-021 whose gaps land in different sentences and therefore in different items. Per section 8.2 the annotated reading is the CARVE-OUT-FREE one, which is STRONGER than the duty the contract imposes; the carve-out verbatim is '(unless an exemption is provided)'. OBLIGOR 'Each party' / OBLIGEE 'the other party': both relational, neither names a party -- section 8.4.1's DISTRIBUTIVE form, added to that section's enumeration at v0.22 (measured separately at 4.7% of pool segments; the identical rationale applies since it names no party either). SPLIT under section 4.3: two governing verbs (deduct / furnish) with genuinely separate objects (taxes / tax receipts), which is section 8.3's 'separate performances' branch, not its one-indivisible-performance branch. ACTION: 'deduct' has no entry in the closed 34-verb taxonomy, but unlike this batch's other near-misses ('analyze' at C04-118, 'dispose' at C02-049, 'invoice' at C02-021) WITHHOLD is a genuinely defensible mapping for withholding taxes, so this item is NOT part of the taxonomy-coverage finding. UNDERSPECIFIED false: section 3.9's three triggers are structural, and an unresolvable party ALIAS is not among them -- matching batch 1's C17-01, also mutual, also underspecified=false. Section 14.2 forbids using the field to record annotator doubt. CORRECTION APPENDED 2026-08-21 (original text above left as written, per this project's corrections-are-new-text discipline): the sentence above lists 'invoice' at C02-021 among verbs with NO defensible taxonomy entry. That is WRONG -- PROVIDE ('provide an invoice') is defensible, and C02-03 is annotated PROVIDE with no section 8.8 tag. The taxonomy-coverage finding stands on perform, amend, request, conduct, manufacture, purchase and specify, which genuinely have no entry.
segment_text: 8.5. TAXES. Each party shall deduct such taxes from the payments due to the other party hereunder as required by law including withholding taxes (unless an exemption is provided), and shall promptly furnish such other party with appropriate tax receipts. Each party will be solely responsible for any and all taxes imposed thereon, including, without limitation, all income taxes, sales taxes, goods and services taxes. Israel value added tax shall be added, if applicable, to all amounts payable hereunder and will be paid against submission of appropriate tax invoices.
